standards_themes_md: standards/THEMES.md, a documentation standard referenced by the base theme's UPGRADING.md guide, which covers the liberu-base to base theme rename.
stat_chart_addbox: A Chart.js layout helper that registers a layout box, such as a scale or legend, to be positioned during chart layout.
stat_chart_ao: A minified helper function in the bundled Chart.js library used by Filament's stats-overview chart widget.
stat_chart_aspectratio: A Chart.js layout helper that computes and returns a chart area's aspect ratio.
stat_chart_beforedatasetdraw: A Chart.js controller/plugin lifecycle hook invoked before a dataset is drawn to the canvas.
stat_chart_beforelayout: A Chart.js controller/plugin lifecycle hook invoked before the chart's layout is computed.
stat_chart_boolean: A Chart.js helper that resolves or validates a configuration value as a boolean.
stat_chart_callback: A Chart.js helper that invokes a given function with arguments if it is callable, otherwise returns undefined.
stat_chart_clearer: A Chart.js animation helper that returns a function used to clear a canvas region between frames.
stat_chart_clone: A Chart.js helper that performs a deep clone of an object or array value.
stat_chart_data: A Chart.js accessor that returns dataset or chart data values.
stat_chart_easeinback: A Chart.js easing function implementing the easeInBack animation timing curve.
stat_chart_easeinoutback: A Chart.js easing function implementing the easeInOutBack animation timing curve.
stat_chart_easeinoutelastic: A Chart.js easing function implementing the easeInOutElastic animation timing curve.
stat_chart_easeoutback: A Chart.js easing function implementing the easeOutBack animation timing curve.
stat_chart_easeoutbounce: A Chart.js easing function implementing the easeOutBounce animation timing curve.
stat_chart_eo: A minified helper function in the bundled Chart.js library used by Filament's stats-overview chart widget.
stat_chart_getdataelement: A Chart.js dataset controller method that returns the rendered visual element for a data index.
stat_chart_getdatavisibility: A Chart.js dataset controller method that returns whether the data point at a given index is currently visible.
stat_chart_getpointlabelposition: A Chart.js radial-scale helper that computes the screen position of a point label.
stat_chart_getscale: A Chart.js accessor that returns the scale instance registered under a given axis id.
stat_chart_getticks: A Chart.js scale method that returns the computed list of tick values for an axis.
stat_chart_getvaluefordistancefromcenter: A Chart.js radial scale helper that converts a pixel distance from the chart's center into a data value.
stat_chart_hn: A minified helper function in the bundled Chart.js library used by Filament's stats-overview chart widget.
stat_chart_inxrange: A Chart.js element method that checks whether a given x pixel coordinate falls within the element's hit-test range.
stat_chart_inyrange: A Chart.js element method that checks whether a given y pixel coordinate falls within the element's hit-test range.
stat_chart_isfullsize: A Chart.js layout helper that checks whether a layout box occupies the full size of its axis.
stat_chart_last: A Chart.js array helper that returns the last element of an array.
stat_chart_lo: A minified helper function in the bundled Chart.js library used by Filament's stats-overview chart widget.
stat_chart_logarithmic: A Chart.js helper related to the logarithmic scale type used for chart axes.
stat_chart_negate: A Chart.js numeric helper that returns the negated value of a number.
stat_chart_number: A Chart.js helper that coerces or validates a configuration value as a number.
stat_chart_opaquer: A Chart.js color helper that returns a color adjusted to a given opacity factor.
stat_chart_options: A Chart.js accessor that returns the resolved options object for a chart element, dataset, or plugin.
stat_chart_platform: A Chart.js accessor that returns the active platform implementation used for DOM and event handling.
stat_chart_plugins: A Chart.js accessor for the chart's registered plugins used during the render lifecycle.
stat_chart_points: A Chart.js helper that returns the point elements associated with a chart dataset.
stat_chart_registry: The Chart.js global registry that holds registered controllers, scales, elements, and plugins.
stat_chart_removebox: A Chart.js layout helper that unregisters a previously added layout box.
stat_chart_rn: A minified helper function in the bundled Chart.js library used by Filament's stats-overview chart widget.
